content: GitHub Actions mixed Python+Node CI shape: separate lint job (fast fail, ruff) and test job (matrix Python versions, fail-fast:false), setup-python cache:pip + setup-node cache:npm, npm ci not npm install, least-privilege permissions (contents: read), timeout-minutes per job, concurrency group with cancel-in-progress on PRs, path filters to skip irrelevant changes. Path-filtered workflows (changed-files) are the standard way to run subsystem-specific checks like lm-evaluation-harness's new_tasks workflow.
